mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_account) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_account WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end}) AS new_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mall_order WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end}) AS order_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM mall_order WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end}) AS order_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mall_order WHERE paid_at >= #{start} AND paid_at < #{end}) AS paid_order_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM mall_order WHERE paid_at >= #{start} AND paid_at < #{end}) AS paid_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payment_refund WHERE refunded_at >= #{start} AND refunded_at < #{end}) AS refund_amount

SELECT item.sku_id, MAX(item.sku_name) AS sku_name, SUM(item.quantity) AS quantity FROM order_item item JOIN mall_order orders ON orders.id = item.order_id WHERE orders.paid_at >= #{start} AND orders.paid_at < #{end} AND orders.status != 8 GROUP BY item.sku_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, item.sku_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
